title: Koine shared building blocks
description: Shared $defs used by every interchange schema — the machine-readable form of the KINP identity.md §7.1 assertion envelope and the KGP grounding-pack.md §7.1 license axis. Field names are contractual: source, source_url, retrieved_at, confidence, license, tier. Do not rename. Absorbed from the deprecated legacy package (ADR-0003), rehomed to the koine namespace.

contractVersion.description: The koine spec version (semver) the emitting side was built against — e.g. KGP `kgp_version`, KFT `kft_version`. Supersedes legacy's single `CONTRACT_VERSION` and its contractVersion-per-artifact discipline (ADR-0003).

license.description: License class per KGP §7.1 (the admission allowlist axis): an SPDX id (e.g. CC0-1.0, CC-BY-4.0, CC-BY-SA-4.0) or an ecosystem pseudo-id from policy/license-classes.json (e.g. PROPRIETARY, PERSONAL).

tier.description: Provenance trust tier per KGP §7 (policy/trust-tiers.json) — the descriptive 'how much to believe a source' axis, separate from the dialect (§5) and egress (§7.2) axes. personal and synthetic are containment-gated.

dialect.description: Logic dialect per KGP §5 — what logic a consumer may safely evaluate: grounding-only (ground facts, no rules), horn-safe (definite Horn clauses), full-prolog (unrestricted). One of legacy's conflated portabilityFlags, now its own axis (ADR-0003). NOTE local-only is NOT a dialect tier — it is an egress class (KGP §5), see the egress $def. Distinct from the egress (§7.2) and trust-tier (§7) axes.

egress.description: Egress class per KGP §7.2 — whether a record may cross a project boundary at all: exportable (default) or local-only. Enforced at pack construction (producer filters local-only out) and on import (consumer rejects local-only and reports). One of legacy's conflated portabilityFlags, now its own axis (ADR-0003); separate from the descriptive provenance trust tier (§7) and the dialect (§5) axis.

csid.description: Canonical entity id: cs:<type>:<local>, QID-anchored when known (cs:language:Q1860). Structurally the KINP entity CURIE (ADR-0002 'csid -> KINP entity CURIE', identity.md §7.1).

claimId.description: The KINP assertion-envelope id (identity.md §7.1): <namespace>:claim:sha256-<hex>, e.g. analyzer:claim:sha256-9f3c…. Content-addressed — the hash of the normalized claim (KGP §3), so identical claims from different producers dedup/merge. Replaces legacy's ad-hoc fact ids (ADR-0003).

assetId.description: Content-addressed asset id — a KMI asset reference (media-interchange.md §2).

nodeRef.description: A graph node reference: either a KINP entity CURIE (csid) or a content-addressed KMI assetId.
